title: Universal Item Grabber - Auto Scan & Grab
features:
📦 Universal Item Grabber

Works in ANY game — auto-scans all ClickDetectors and ProximityPrompts.

🔍 Auto scan — finds all grabbable items automatically
⚡ 5 speed modes (x1, x2, x5, x10, MAX)
🔄 One-click grab all items
🎯 ClickDetector + ProximityPrompt support
🔄 Auto return to original position after grab

How to use:
1. Run the script
2. Press "🔍 Scan"
3. Click items or "📦 Grab All"
4. Adjust speed with ⚡ button
